name: Avatar Natural Foods
old_description: Avatar Natural Foods is a food service company that specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of exclusive gourmet products.
about:
Avatar Natural Foods was founded in 2011 in Henderson, Nevada. The company operates from a 70,000‑square‑foot facility that houses production and test kitchens for its sister brands — YaYa’s Kitchen, Tuscany Cookies, Eat Pita, Bettr Bowl and Cali Crumble. Chef Diego Silva, the creator of Eat Pita, is the driving force behind the company’s vision of clean, healthy, affordable American food.

The business manufactures and distributes a catalog of hundreds of all‑natural, preservative‑free products, including deli salads, Mediterranean dips, grab‑and‑go meals, baked goods, pita bread, pita chips, frozen meals and cookies. It offers private‑label development, co‑packing with package design and shipping, wholesale distribution and e‑commerce fulfillment with 24‑hour order processing. The plant is FDA‑registered, USDA‑organic certified, HACCP and GMP compliant.

Customers range from independent retailers, supermarkets, greengrocers and delicatessens to garden centers, pound shops, cash‑and‑carry outlets and expatriate shops across the continental United States. The company also serves e‑commerce brands needing fulfillment services.

Avatar was built on the premise that managing every step — from ingredient sourcing through production to distribution — keeps costs down and quality up. Its differentiators are a certified facility, in‑house test kitchens, a broad private‑label and co‑packing program, and a commitment to clean‑label ingredients without artificial flavors, colors or preservatives.
